summary.text: Kelly Chapman is the Republican candidate for Nevada State Assembly District 41, an open seat, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat Vinny Spotleson.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she has spent nearly 30 years working in Nevada's gaming industry.

paragraphs.text: Chapman earned a high school diploma from Chaparral High School and has worked in hospitality management.
In her 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she said she has lived in Las Vegas for 47 years and worked her way up from blackjack dealer to high-limit casino pitboss.
Chapman was the Republican nominee for Nevada State Assembly District 8 in 2024 and lost the general election to incumbent Duy Nguyen, 53.6 percent to 46.4 percent.
She won the June 9, 2026 Republican primary for District 41 over Tofuola Alofipo with 53.7 percent of the vote.
In her 2026 survey, she listed affordability, safe neighborhoods and accountability, and better schools and opportunities for children as her key messages.
